```{python}
#| label: setup
import re
import base64
from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from IPython.display import display, HTML

IMPUTED_DIR = Path("/home/ood-coffm049/hbcdData/imputed")
CHUNKS = ["c1", "c2", "c3"]

# ── parsers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def parse_qc_report(path):
    text = path.read_text()
    metrics = {}
    patterns = {
        "Reference Overlap (%)":        r"Reference Overlap:\s*([\d.]+)\s*%",
        "Match":                        r"Match:\s*([\d,]+)",
        "Allele switch":                r"Allele switch:\s*([\d,]+)",
        "Strand flip":                  r"Strand flip:\s*([\d,]+)",
        "Strand flip + allele switch":  r"Strand flip and allele switch:\s*([\d,]+)",
        "A/T, C/G genotypes":          r"A/T, C/G genotypes:\s*([\d,]+)",
        "Filter flag set":              r"Filter flag set:\s*([\d,]+)",
        "Invalid alleles":              r"Invalid alleles:\s*([\d,]+)",
        "Multiallelic sites":           r"Multiallelic sites:\s*([\d,]+)",
        "Duplicated sites":             r"Duplicated sites:\s*([\d,]+)",
        "NonSNP sites":                 r"NonSNP sites:\s*([\d,]+)",
        "Monomorphic sites":            r"Monomorphic sites:\s*([\d,]+)",
        "Allele mismatch":              r"Allele mismatch:\s*([\d,]+)",
        "SNPs call rate < 90%":         r"SNPs call rate < 90%:\s*([\d,]+)",
        "Excluded sites (total)":       r"Excluded sites in total:\s*([\d,]+)",
        "Remaining sites (total)":      r"Remaining sites in total:\s*([\d,]+)",
        "Typed only sites":             r"Typed only sites:\s*([\d,]+)",
        "Chunks excluded":              r"(\d+)\s*Chunk\(s\) excluded:",
        "Remaining chunks":             r"Remaining chunk\(s\):\s*(\d+)",
    }
    for name, pat in patterns.items():
        m = re.search(pat, text)
        if m:
            val = m.group(1).replace(",", "")
            try:
                metrics[name] = int(val)
            except ValueError:
                metrics[name] = float(val)
    return metrics


def parse_snps_excluded(path):
    df = pd.read_csv(path, sep=r"\s+")
    return df["INFO"].value_counts()


def parse_snps_typed_only(path):
    df = pd.read_csv(path, sep=r"\s+")
    return df["CHROM"].value_counts().sort_index()


def parse_chunks_excluded(path):
    return pd.read_csv(path, sep=r"\s+")


def embed_html_collapsible(path):
    if not path.exists():
        display(HTML("<p><em>quality-control.html not found</em></p>"))
        return
    try:
        content = path.read_bytes()
        b64 = base64.b64encode(content).decode()
        src = f"data:text/html;base64,{b64}"
        display(HTML(
            '<details><summary>quality-control.html</summary>'
            f'<iframe src="{src}" width="100%" height="600px" '
            'style="border:1px solid #ccc;border-radius:4px;"></iframe>'
            '</details>'
        ))
    except Exception:
        display(HTML(
            f'<details><summary>quality-control.html</summary>'
            f'<p><a href="file:///{path.as_posix()}" target="_blank">Open file</a></p>'
            '</details>'
        ))


def report_chunk(ch, data):
    qc = data.get("qc", {})

    # ── metrics ──
    if qc:
        cats = [
            ("Reference", ["Reference Overlap (%)", "Match"]),
            ("Strand / Allele", ["Allele switch", "Strand flip",
                                 "Strand flip + allele switch", "A/T, C/G genotypes"]),
            ("Filtered sites", ["Filter flag set", "Invalid alleles",
                                "Multiallelic sites", "Duplicated sites",
                                "NonSNP sites", "Monomorphic sites",
                                "Allele mismatch", "SNPs call rate < 90%"]),
            ("Summary", ["Excluded sites (total)", "Remaining sites (total)",
                         "Typed only sites", "Chunks excluded", "Remaining chunks"]),
        ]
        for group, keys in cats:
            print(f"**{group}**")
            for k in keys:
                if k in qc:
                    print(f"- {k}: **{qc[k]:,}**")
            print()

    # ── excluded SNPs bar chart ──
    if "snps_excluded" in data:
        counts = data["snps_excluded"]
        fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, max(3, len(counts) * 0.35)))
        colors = plt.cm.Set2(np.linspace(0, 1, len(counts)))
        bars = ax.barh(counts.index, counts.values, color=colors, edgecolor="k", linewidth=0.5)
        ax.set_xlabel("SNPs excluded")
        ax.set_title(f"Excluded SNPs by reason ({ch})")
        for b, v in zip(bars, counts.values):
            ax.text(v + max(counts.values) * 0.01,
                    b.get_y() + b.get_height() / 2,
                    f"{v:,}", va="center", fontsize=9)
        plt.tight_layout()
        plt.show()
    else:
        print("*No snps-excluded.txt found*")

    # ── typed-only SNPs bar chart ──
    if "snps_typed" in data:
        counts = data["snps_typed"]
        fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, max(3, len(counts) * 0.35)))
        colors = plt.cm.Pastel1(np.linspace(0, 1, len(counts)))
        bars = ax.barh(counts.index.astype(str), counts.values,
                       color=colors, edgecolor="k", linewidth=0.5)
        ax.set_xlabel("Typed-only SNPs")
        ax.set_title(f"Typed-only SNPs by chromosome ({ch})")
        for b, v in zip(bars, counts.values):
            ax.text(v + max(counts.values) * 0.01,
                    b.get_y() + b.get_height() / 2,
                    f"{v:,}", va="center", fontsize=9)
        plt.tight_layout()
        plt.show()
    else:
        print("*No snps-typed-only.txt found*")

    # ── chunks excluded table ──
    ce = data.get("chunks_excluded")
    if ce is not None and len(ce):
        print("**Chunks excluded (< 20 SNPs)**")
        display(ce.style.set_table_attributes('class="table table-sm"'))
    else:
        print("*No excluded chunks*")

    # ── qc html embed ──
    embed_html_collapsible(data.get("html_path", Path("/dev/null")))


# ── load all chunk data ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

chunk_data = {}
for ch in CHUNKS:
    d = {}
    base = IMPUTED_DIR / ch

    qc_path = base / "qc_report.txt"
    if qc_path.exists():
        d["qc"] = parse_qc_report(qc_path)

    excl_path = base / "statistics" / "snps-excluded.txt"
    if excl_path.exists():
        d["snps_excluded"] = parse_snps_excluded(excl_path)

    typed_path = base / "statistics" / "snps-typed-only.txt"
    if typed_path.exists():
        d["snps_typed"] = parse_snps_typed_only(typed_path)

    chunks_excl_path = base / "statistics" / "chunks-excluded.txt"
    if chunks_excl_path.exists():
        d["chunks_excluded"] = parse_chunks_excluded(chunks_excl_path)
    else:
        d["chunks_excluded"] = None

    d["html_path"] = base / "quality-control.html"

    chunk_data[ch] = d
```

## QC Summary by Chunk {.panel-tabset}

```{python}
#| label: summary-table
rows = []
for ch in CHUNKS:
    qc = chunk_data[ch].get("qc", {})
    rows.append({
        "Chunk": ch,
        "Reference Overlap (%)": qc.get("Reference Overlap (%)", "—"),
        "Remaining sites": qc.get("Remaining sites (total)", "—"),
        "Excluded sites": qc.get("Excluded sites (total)", "—"),
        "Typed only": qc.get("Typed only sites", "—"),
        "Chunks excluded": qc.get("Chunks excluded", "—"),
    })
summary = pd.DataFrame(rows).set_index("Chunk")
display(summary.style.set_table_attributes('class="table table-sm"').format(precision=2, na_rep="—"))
```

### c1

```{python}
#| label: c1
report_chunk("c1", chunk_data["c1"])
```
